project_info.theme: Adidas exclusive Shopee debut running-shoe poster
project_info.color_palette: Off-white, black, Adidas red, Shopee orange, gray

main_subject.detail: A clean minimal footwear poster with top branding from Shopee, Adidas, and Shopee Debut. The main headline says 'ADIZERO PACER' and the red banner below reads 'DOC QUYEN TREN SHOPEE'. At top right is a countdown badge 'CON 2 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. Two gray Adidas running shoes with bright red three stripes are placed diagonally on a pale tiled floor. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'.
main_subject.style: Minimal product-launch poster with editorial whitespace, realistic shoe photography, and crisp retail typography

composition_elements.text: SHOPEE DEBUT / ADIZERO PACER / DOC QUYEN TREN SHOPEE / CON 2 NGAY / NGAY 15 / SALE GIUA THANG / MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE / (*) Chi tiet chuong trinh (bao gom cac truong hop loai tru) xem tai trang Mien Phi Van Chuyen tren Ung dung Shopee
items: Top Left: Shopee logo and Adidas logo

Bottom Left: Fine-print disclaimer area over the tile background

Center/Background: Large black title typography over a pale stone-tile floor with two gray running shoes featuring bright red stripes

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Realistic floor shadows, clean product contrast, minimal glare, calm premium feel

technical_specs.render_style: Product-launch poster with photo-real shoe rendering and minimalist commercial layout

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Adidas on Shopee Debut. Centerpiece is a pair of realistic gray Adizero Pacer running shoes with bright red three stripes placed diagonally on a pale tiled floor. Background is a minimal off-white retail layout with large black title typography. Surrounding elements: Shopee logo, Adidas logo, Shopee Debut badge, headline 'ADIZERO PACER', red banner 'DOC QUYEN TREN SHOPEE', top-right countdown badge 'CON 2 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG', fine-print disclaimer, and bottom CTA 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'. Technical style: product-launch poster with photo-real shoe rendering and minimalist commercial layout, soft studio daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
